title: REST APIs Knowledge Check
description: Check your understanding of REST resources, CRUD endpoints, status codes, pagination, OpenAPI, SSE, WebSockets, and webhooks.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: In REST API design, what should URLs usually represent?
questions.explanation: REST APIs are organized around resources, with HTTP methods expressing actions.

questions.prompt: Which status code is most appropriate after successfully creating a resource?
questions.explanation: `201 Created` communicates that the server created a new resource.

questions.prompt: What is OpenAPI commonly used for?
questions.explanation: OpenAPI specifications describe endpoints, request bodies, responses, and schemas.

questions.prompt: When is a webhook typically used?

options.text: When one system needs to notify another system about an event

questions.explanation: Webhooks are event callbacks delivered over HTTP between systems.
